dogRules.text: Campgrounds and pet-friendly lodging available.
Not on ranger programs.
Some trails are closed to pets; check the list.

properties.name: Theodore Roosevelt National Park
properties.summary: Dogs are not permitted on trails within the park.

excerpts.quote: While dogs are not permitted on trails within the park, there are nearby trails where you can take your dogs for some exercise.

dogRules.text: The Maah Daah Hey Trail outside the park allows pets.

properties.name: Virgin Islands National Park
properties.summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on trails, but not on beaches.

excerpts.quote: Service dogs are allowed in Virgin Islands National Park and leashed dogs are allowed on trails.

dogRules.text: No pets on beaches.

properties.name: Voyageurs National Park
properties.summary: Pets are allowed in developed areas and on the Rainy Lake Recreation Trail, not other trails or the backcountry.

excerpts.quote: Pets are NOT allowed on park trails (except the Rainy Lake Recreation Trail) or in the backcountry.

dogRules.text: Developed areas, the four main lakes and entrance roads.
Dog sleds allowed on frozen lakes; permit needed on snowmobile portages.

properties.name: White Sands National Park
properties.summary: Leashed pets are welcome in the park, but not in the visitor center or gift shop.

excerpts.quote: Visitors are welcome to bring their pets to the park as long as they are kept on a leash.

dogRules.text: Not in federal buildings.
Do not leave a pet tied to an object.

properties.name: Wind Cave National Park
properties.summary: Pets are barred from most trails and the backcountry, with a few exceptions.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not allowed on any other trail or in the backcountry.

dogRules.text: Prairie Vista Trail, picnic area and campground allow leashed pets.

properties.name: Wrangell–St. Elias National Park and Preserve
properties.summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on trails and in the backcountry.

excerpts.quote: Dogs are allowed on trails within the park and in the backcountry.

dogRules.text: Not in visitor centers or ranger stations.
Leash in the Kennecott Mines area.

properties.name: Yellowstone National Park
properties.summary: Pets must stay within 100 feet of roads, parking areas and campgrounds.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not allowed on boardwalks, hiking trails, in the backcountry, or in thermal areas.

dogRules.text: Within 100 ft of roads, parking areas and campgrounds only.
Carried pets are not allowed in these areas either.

properties.name: Yosemite National Park
properties.summary: Pets are allowed on paved valley paths and the Wawona Meadow Loop, not hiking trails.

excerpts.quote: While dogs are generally allowed on paved trails on the floor of Yosemite, they must be leashed and their excrement must be disposed of in waste receptacles.

dogRules.text: Not on trails including Vernal Fall, even if carried; Wawona Meadow Loop is open to pets.
No exceptions for carried pets.

properties.name: Zion National Park
properties.summary: Pets are welcome on roads, campgrounds and the Zion Lodge grounds; the Pa’rus Trail is the only trail that allows them.

excerpts.quote: Properly restrained pets are welcome along public roads and parking areas, in developed campgrounds and picnic areas, and on the grounds of the Zion Lodge.

dogRules.text: Roads, parking areas, campgrounds, picnic areas and Zion Lodge grounds allowed.
Not on other trails, wilderness, shuttles or buildings.
No retractable leashes over 6 ft.
May be left in campgrounds only when conditions are safe.
